notes: Numeric fields are numbers, not strings. Ranges are [low, high].
nameplate_energy vs usable_energy and power vs energy are kept in separate fields on purpose.
equipment_only vs installed is stated in 'scope' for every cost claim.
Currency 'USD'/'EUR' and price_year are never silently converted; no verified 2025 EUR/USD rate was obtained.

claims.meaning: Commercial 2-hour grid battery unit: AC power and nominal energy per unit, Tesla Megapack 2 XL (2-hour configuration)
claims.scope: manufacturer datasheet, one unit, nominal energy at 25 C, AC side
claims.evidence_strength: primary manufacturer datasheet read directly; single product
claims.recommended_baseline: use P = E/2 for the decision variable and apply the 1.927 MW / 3.854 MWh module grid at reporting

claims.meaning: Module grid rule: integer number of commercial units rather than continuous custom capacity
claims.scope: one verified product only; other vendors not surveyed
claims.evidence_strength: primary datasheet (module sizing); catalogue breadth weak
claims.recommended_baseline: continuous E in the baseline L(P), integer modules as a robustness check; report residual

claims.meaning: Reference commercial utility-scale storage system used by an industry cost benchmark
claims.scope: modelled reference system (US project data), not a product
claims.evidence_strength: primary industry benchmark document read directly
claims.recommended_baseline: use as the scale reference for the utility-scale capex claim

claims.meaning: Installed CAPEX of a 2-hour grid BESS, reconstructed from the Danish Energy Agency component tables
claims.unit: million EUR per MWh of nameplate energy
claims.scope: installed / EPC overnight cost; includes shallow grid connection and 10% EPC; excludes VAT, deep reinforcement, land, decommissioning, interest during construction, owners' predevelopment
claims.evidence_strength: primary catalogue, arithmetic reconstruction from its own 2025 cost elements (helper-read front matter, directly-read Tables 8 and 10)
claims.recommended_baseline: 0.29 (matches the brief's 0.288 within +3.5%)

claims.meaning: Brief's indicative battery investment cost, for comparison with B-02-01
claims.unit: million EUR per MWh of storage capacity
claims.scope: brief assumption; price year and cost-scope boundary not stated in the brief
claims.evidence_strength: course brief (authoritative requirement, not market evidence)
claims.recommended_baseline: keep as the baseline number, now with a documented scope and price year borrowed from DEA

claims.meaning: Total initial installed cost of a 100 MW / 200 MWh (2 h) standalone storage system
claims.scope: installed; DC capital + AC (power) + EPC, includes 10% overbuild per Lazard note; US real-project data
claims.evidence_strength: primary industry benchmark, computed from its own cost lines and reported total
claims.recommended_baseline: cross-check only; not converted to EUR (no verified FX rate)

claims.meaning: Scale effect on capital cost: C&I 1 MW / 2 MWh versus utility 100 MW / 200 MWh
claims.scope: DC capital cost only (equipment + installation before EPC in this line)
claims.evidence_strength: primary benchmark, same document and method for both scales
claims.recommended_baseline: use as the only defensible evidence of scale effect (roughly 2x penalty at 1 MW)

claims.meaning: Balance-of-plant and grid-connection cost elements for a grid BESS (2025 values)
claims.unit: million EUR 2020 per MWh or per MW
claims.scope: component costs inside the plant boundary; grid connection is shallow only (transformer, metering, breakers)
claims.evidence_strength: primary catalogue table read directly (Table 10, p.181)
claims.recommended_baseline: embed in B-02-01 rather than modelling separately

claims.meaning: Round-trip efficiency (AC-AC where stated) of a 2-hour grid battery
claims.scope: full-cycle including power conversion and thermal losses where the source states it; PNNL transformer-level is whole-plant AC
claims.evidence_strength: three independent sources agree within 0.87-0.92; PNNL conservative end 0.826

claims.meaning: Convention for splitting round-trip efficiency into charge and discharge efficiencies
claims.scope: modelling convention (symmetric split), not a measured value
claims.evidence_strength: arithmetic convention; sqrt(0.90)
claims.recommended_baseline: eta_charge = eta_discharge = sqrt(RTE)

claims.meaning: Power rating relative to energy capacity for the brief's 2-hour asset
claims.scope: duration specification from the brief, confirmed by a commercial product at exactly 2.000 h
claims.evidence_strength: requirement plus manufacturer confirmation
claims.recommended_baseline: charge_t <= P and discharge_t <= P with P = 0.5 * E

claims.meaning: Normal state-of-charge operating window and resulting usable energy
claims.scope: team/brief assumption; not a datasheet value and not sourced here
claims.evidence_strength: requirement (written brief), unsourced assumption
claims.recommended_baseline: SOC in [0.20E, 0.80E]; usable energy 0.60E; note only 1.2 h at rated power

claims.meaning: Standby / self-discharge loss while idle
claims.unit: fraction of stored energy per day
claims.scope: no public figure obtained for a grid BESS; thermal losses are already inside a stated RTE
claims.evidence_strength: gap - no source obtained

claims.meaning: Power conversion system cost element (PCS including DC-DC)
claims.scope: equipment component cost inside the DEA investment boundary, 2025 value
claims.evidence_strength: primary catalogue table read directly (Table 10, p.181)
claims.recommended_baseline: used only inside B-02-01 and B-04-06

claims.meaning: Asset economic life and warranty term
claims.scope: warranty term from manufacturer datasheet; project life from industry benchmark; calendar life from national-lab assessment
claims.evidence_strength: primary sources, but the three use different definitions (warranty vs economic life vs calendar life)
claims.recommended_baseline: 15 years (within the standard warranty), 20 years as a sensitivity

claims.meaning: Cycle life to the halfway (80%) state-of-health point at 80% average depth of discharge
claims.scope: PNNL ESGC 2022 modelling assumption, 80% average DOD, to halfway SoH
claims.evidence_strength: primary national-lab assessment (Table 4.3, p.22), helper-extracted locator
claims.recommended_baseline: state cycle budget explicitly; 20 y x 350 cycles = 7000 > 2400, so replacement/augmentation must be costed

claims.meaning: Implied cycling limit on the asset from warranty practice and benchmark operation
claims.scope: market practice / benchmark modelling convention, not a contractual term in the datasheet
claims.evidence_strength: benchmark assumption plus reported warranty practice
claims.recommended_baseline: discharge_t <= 0.60 * E per day (one cycle of usable energy)

claims.meaning: Fixed operating and maintenance cost
claims.unit: percent of capex per year; USD per kW-year; USD per kWh-year
claims.scope: PNNL: bottom-up components plus 30% power-equipment refurbishment every 10 y; Lazard: all-in market O&M for a 2 h utility asset
claims.evidence_strength: conflict: the two imply roughly 1.2 EUR/kWh-yr (PNNL at 0.29 m/MWh) vs 3.0-8.2 USD/kWh-yr (Lazard)
claims.recommended_baseline: EUR 3.0 per kWh-year, flagged as unresolved

claims.meaning: Extended warranty expense after the included period
claims.unit: percent of capital cost per year
claims.scope: 2-hour utility-scale standalone storage case
claims.evidence_strength: primary benchmark assumption
claims.recommended_baseline: omit from the base case (warranty assumed included for 15 y); include in the augmentation sensitivity

claims.meaning: Replacement / augmentation cash flow
claims.unit: fraction of power-equipment cost; interval in years; EUR 2020 per MWh of energy capacity
claims.scope: PNNL refurbishment assumption applied to the DEA PCS cost element (0.30 x 0.069 / 2)
claims.evidence_strength: derived by combining two primary sources; the combination is my inference, not a published figure
claims.recommended_baseline: include a year-10 refurbishment equal to 30% of PCS cost

claims.meaning: Residual / salvage / disposal value at end of horizon
claims.scope: no public figure obtained; DEA explicitly excludes decommissioning from investment cost
claims.evidence_strength: gap - no source obtained

claims.meaning: Recommended sensitivity band on installed battery capex
claims.unit: million EUR per MWh of nameplate energy
claims.scope: 2-hour installed cost; upper bound derived from Lazard's USD range, so partly dependent on an unverified FX rate
claims.evidence_strength: bounded range, wide; upper bound uncertain because FX was not verified

claims.meaning: Bulk / quantity discount schedule for grid BESS
claims.scope: no citable public schedule obtained; DEA states it applies no economy-of-scale rule and its values are valid only near the reference capacity
claims.evidence_strength: gap - absence of public evidence, not absence of the phenomenon
claims.recommended_baseline: no discount curve; two-step scale sensitivity using B-02-04 (utility vs C&I)

claims.meaning: Operating-days convention for annualised cycling
claims.scope: industry benchmark assumption for a standalone storage asset
claims.evidence_strength: benchmark assumption
claims.recommended_baseline: cap extrapolated annual cycles at 350, disclose that a daily historical model could imply 365

claims.meaning: Daily-resolution throughput convention for a 2-hour asset
claims.unit: fraction of nameplate energy per day
claims.scope: modelling convention required because daily data contain one price per day
claims.evidence_strength: convention triangulated by warranty practice and benchmark operation
claims.recommended_baseline: discharge_t <= 0.60 * E; charge_t <= 0.60 * E

claims.meaning: Prohibition of simultaneous charging and discharging in the same day
claims.scope: with a single daily price, same-day round trip is unprofitable by construction, so the LP may avoid it without binaries; this must be verified, not assumed, especially with negative prices
claims.evidence_strength: structural argument from the data resolution; requires an ex-post check
claims.recommended_baseline: add binaries in a validation run, or assert max same-day charge+discharge is below tolerance

claims.meaning: Intraday arbitrage value that daily data cannot represent
claims.scope: all supplied price series are daily; a 2-hour asset's main real-world revenue is intraday
claims.evidence_strength: structural limitation of the supplied data
claims.recommended_baseline: label all battery results as inter-day arbitrage plus avoided curtailment only; no intraday claim

claims.meaning: Mandatory throughput diagnostics for any battery result
value: share of charge from otherwise-unused generation
claims.scope: needed to interpret any profit figure
claims.evidence_strength: modelling recommendation
claims.recommended_baseline: report all five in the run output
